metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from brutal: deterministic checks run after each edit, and skills for projects made with create-brutal.

plugins.name: brutal-checks
plugins.description: Runs @brutalway/agent-hook after each Edit or Write: oxlint on the edited file, alint and check-tree when a file is created. Errors go back to Claude.

plugins.name: brutal-skills
plugins.description: Skills for projects made with create-brutal: brutalway-update merges the changes of the template into the project and brings npm run check back to where it was.
